Full summary: Investigated wave-2 field defects D9-D13: all confirmed/accepted via dual independent investigation + adversarial verification; disposition doc written to docs/field-responses/2026-08-12-wave2-response.md. No fixes shipped.
Decisions: Chose to keep the duplicate Workflow replication running after the four teammate agents turned out alive — two independent investigations per defect plus per-claim adversarial verification gave corroboration; every root-cause claim across all four defects came back CONFIRMED, at the cost of ~640k subagent tokens under the ultracode directive; Chose the authoritative sqlite mirror (.twining/records/decisions/) over the legacy v1 directories for all store measurements — the D13 agent's low-yield conclusion (2/13 recoverable) came from the stale v1 store; on the mirror 78/89 empty-affected_files decisions carry provenance.commit_sha (~90% yield), which inverted the ask-1 design from fallback to primary backlog mechanism; Rejected field ask D12(a) rank-by-recency-x-severity as specified — the lane is already recency-dominant ranked (confidence and warning_boost are constants), so the ask would entrench the self-post dilution; accepted replacement is scopeProximity dampening plus a semantic-admission relevance floor; Declined D10(a) partial supersession as a data-model change touching every active-status filter plus a 3k-record migration — chose write-time decomposition instead: per-decision supersedes on the structured decision object, which also fixes the record-tools.ts:414 fan-out amplifier; Sequenced D13 ask 4 (declared-vs-derived relation marker with confidence vocabulary) BEFORE ask 1 (commit-provenance derivation) — deriving first would leave ~2,300 unmarked legacy edges permanently indistinguishable from inferred ones; Reclassified onPost's relates_to graph population as a defect rather than a feature gap — it writes related_to edges targeting blackboard entry IDs that are never graph entities, the NOT_FOUND is swallowed, and 1 of 2,352 live relations proves it dead in practice
Findings: warning: D7 is NOT fixed at HEAD and was never tracked — nested structured-decision affected_files is stripped by zod AND clobbered by the loop-level session default (record-tools.ts:416); dogfood store reproduces the field ratio (89/487 = 18.3% empty vs field 17.7%); warning: two counting stores diverge on this repo — legacy .twining/decisions/ (170 records, stale since Jul 5) vs authoritative .twining/records/decisions/ (487); always measure on records/ or the db, one investigation already published a wrong yield estimate from the v1 directory; Fix waves proposed in the disposition doc: Wave A response-shape (D9 count plumbing, D10 superseded visibility + fan-out guard, D12 age stamps + scopeless-handoff default), Wave B schema-additive (D7 per-decision fields, D11 twining_amend under four invariants, D12 self-post marking), Wave C derivation (D13 marker then unified bulk pass with child-commit resolution); need: two read-only measurements requested from the field repo before building D13 ask 1 — their empty-affected_files x has-commit-ref split on the sqlite store, and whether they run tools.mode lite (graph write tools are default-surface, contradicting their premise)
summary: Investigated wave-2 field defects D9-D13: all confirmed/accepted via dual independent investigation + adversarial verification; disposition doc written to docs/field-responses/2026-08-12-wave2-resp…
